description: What forge-bridge src/collision.js adds to rotn-data's per-state playerCollision for modded blocks: walk-through is opt-in (only the states listed in walkThrough; any other state a player has no box in is a solid full cube), liquid marks modded fluids, hazard/hazardByMeta mark trap, fire, portal, web and lava blocks; checks records what the tool verified in the data. Built by packages/forge-bridge/tools/build-collision-overrides.mjs from the pinned server pack zip (rules in its header); no mod code run.

dynamicLeaves.evidence: mods/DramaticTrees-1.12.2-0.13.4.jar (SHA-256 b86dae768ccc1182c52e5b9a8756a5906da53dc125d48bfe1c8dc69204a77ffe): BlockDynamicLeaves.addCollisionBoxToList (func_185477_a) gives a player vanilla's full cube if Passable Leaves is loaded or vanillaLeavesCollision is true, nothing if isLeavesPassable is true, else AxisAlignedBB(0.125, 0, 0.125, 0.875, 0.5, 0.875) (bytecode 96-128). On the pack: config/dynamictrees.cfg isLeavesPassable=false (line 60), vanillaLeavesCollision=false (line 66), mod passableleaves not in the pack
